DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 04 s. 2023 January 18, 2023 HON. EPITACIO D. AYANGCO Sangguniang Bayan Member Macalelon, Quezon Dear Hon. Ayangco: This has reference to your email dated August 9, 2022 requesting for this Department's legal opinion with regard to your step increment 3 where your grant was removed upon being elected as a regular member of the sangguniang bayan. The following facts are obtained from your narrative, as follows: • Based on your representations, you were the Punong Barangay (PB) of Olongtao Ibaba Macalelon, Quezon in 2010, 2013 and 2018 respectively. After being elected as PB in 2013, you ran and won as ABC President of the Liga ng mga Barangayin your municipality where you held the position of ex-officio member of the sangguniang bayan until 2022 where the subject grant of step increment was given. • However, in the recently concluded national elections last 9 May 2022, you ran this time as a regular member of the sangguniang bayan and won as sangguniang bayan member. Hence, your request for an opinion on whether your entitlement to step increment 3 may be removed. We answer in the affirmative. Pursuant to the Civil Service and Commission and Department of Budget Management Joint Circular No. 01 s. 2016 dated 27 January 2016 re: Rules and Regulations on the Grant of Step Increments to Elective Officials Based on Length of Service, the grant of step increments to elective officials shall be based on length of service. These elective officials shall enjoy this benefit as a form of reward for completing their term of office and being re-elected to the same position. On a note, the subject Joint Circular, specifically, Sec. 4.2.,3 provides that the coverage only applies to elective officials in cities and municipalities, e.g., mayors, vice mayors, and regular and ex-officio members of the Sangguning Panlungsod/Bayan. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

In addition, Sec. 5.0 excluded from the coverage elective barangay officials. Hence, it is understood that you were given the step increment as an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan, having been elected as the ABC President of the Liga ng mga Barangay in your municipality, and not as a Punong Barangay. Considering that you are a newly elected regular Sangguniang Barangay Member this time, we submit that the removal of your step increment is just and reasonable. We reiterate, that step increment is awarded to the elective officials who completed their term of office and being re-elected to the same position. Notwithstanding, we would like to emphasize that this opinion is rendered based solely on the facts you have provided to the Department and our appreciation of the same. This opinion is without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of competent authorities or courts. Finally, this opinion may vary depending on the facts changed or elaborated. We hope to have assisted you on this matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU RITY OF THE SECRETARY: VI R R.
